dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' structures and semi-enclosed 'C' structures are visible on the posterior lateral flank. The perimeters consist of high-intensity pixels transitioning sharply to lower-intensity internal cores, particularly prominent in a cluster of interconnected rings near the mid-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of small, solid high-intensity white and grey spots are located on the head and neck regions, lacking internal gradients. Scattered high-intensity pixels are also distributed between the larger macro-annuli on the lower flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary macro-annuli on the mid-posterior flank form an irregular quadrilateral geometry. A triangular relationship is observed between three prominent high-intensity blobs located posterior to the ocular region.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, interconnected lattice-like pattern is present where several macro-annuli share boundary edges, creating a tessellated appearance on the upper flank.
